inputs.text: Hand-painted 2D inventory icon of a rounded green jade waist pendant. Preserve the diagonal bamboo and the deep green shadow along the jade rim. Carve round cloud scrolls into the open corners, a repeating angular fret band at the top and foot, and tiny leaf veins. Set a few muted gold strokes into the carving. Soft jade bevels, rich emerald surface, clear large forms, dark ink contour, pierced suspension ear, burgundy cord and single fan tassel, isolated on a flat magenta field.
